verdict.rationale: stagewise is itself an agentic IDE with a built-in coding agent. Per the docs, the agent reads, writes and edits files, runs shell commands, drives browser tabs and orchestrates multi-step workflows, and several agents can run in parallel. Users can review every edit through diffs and undo it, and community users report hands-on use of the in-product agent. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of complex multi-step delegated tasks beyond small UI edits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: stagewise is a standalone desktop IDE where AI coding agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces.
The agent can read and edit files, run shell commands, interact with browser tabs via CDP, and orchestrate complex multi-step workflows.
stagewise supports multiple agent instances running in parallel. Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
Diff review — Accept, reject, or undo every agent edit with full inline diffs
